summary: Supervise canonical Termux OpenSSH listener on port 8022 with the existing Samantha Health Manager.
reason: RDC-launched ad-hoc sshd processes disappeared after the launching session ended, causing repeated Connection refused from the laptop. Termux sshd_config already defines canonical port 8022.

capabilities.reason: Extends the existing Health Manager to restore the already-installed Termux OpenSSH listener; no new execution plane.

architecture.reason: No new daemon, scheduler, store, router or orchestrator. Reuses existing Health Manager.

rollback: Revert this commit and promote the previous immutable Tier0 release.
limitations: Tailscale must remain connected for remote laptop access.
